queries.name: sql.identityRow.prepare.0
queries.sql:
SELECT identity.identity_id AS identityId,
        identity.platform_principal_id AS platformPrincipalId,
        identity.issuer,
        identity.external_subject AS subject,
        principal.principal,
        identity.identifier,
        principal.kind,
        identity.assurance,
        identity.status,
        identity.revision,
        identity.created_at AS createdAt,
        identity.updated_at AS updatedAt,
        identity.profile,
        principal.status AS principalStatus,
        principal.revision AS principalRevision
      FROM host_identities AS identity
      JOIN platform_principals AS principal
        ON principal.platform_principal_id = identity.platform_principal_id
      WHERE identity.identity_id = ?

queries.name: sql.provisionIdentity.prepare.0
sql.provisionIdentity.prepare.1
queries.sql:
INSERT INTO host_identities (
          identity_id, platform_principal_id, issuer, external_subject, principal, identifier, kind, assurance,
          status, revision, created_at, updated_at, profile
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'active', ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(identity_id) DO UPDATE SET
          identifier = excluded.identifier,
          kind = excluded.kind,
          assurance = excluded.assurance,
          revision = excluded.revision,
          updated_at = excluded.updated_at,
          profile = excluded.profile
